test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: If P + Q means P is the brother of Q, P × Q means P is the mother of Q, P÷ Q means P is the father of Q and P - Q means P is the sister of Q. If A × B + C - D ÷ E - F, then how is E related to A?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother 
 Sister 
 Mother 
 Father
 
 

 

Given: A × B + C - D ÷ E - F

It means: A is the mother of B, B is the brother of C, C is the sister of D, D is the father of E and E is the sister of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e343d46f28155a29e0e8d98c7a9e820c3a9b806bcafc4aa1e2be3e1289299cdc.png] 

So, E is the **'Son's daughter' **of A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
